usage: deskops list [-h]
                    {tasks,pills,rituals,boards,atoms,materializations,repositories,reviews,inbox-notes,faq-docs,steps,roles,runtime-profiles} ...

List desk workflow artifacts.

positional arguments:
  {tasks,pills,rituals,boards,atoms,materializations,repositories,reviews,inbox-notes,faq-docs,steps,roles,runtime-profiles}
    tasks               List actionable tasks.
    pills               List pills.
    rituals             List rituals.
    boards              List boards.
    atoms               List atoms.
    materializations    List materializations.
    repositories        List repositories.
    reviews             List reviews.
    inbox-notes         List inbox-notes.
    faq-docs            List faq-docs.
    steps               List steps.
    roles               List roles.
    runtime-profiles    List runtime-profiles.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops list tasks --root .
  deskops list pills --root .
  deskops list atoms --root .
